title: Refining GLSDC for Orbit Determination
summary: This paper investigates the ambiguity of noisy short-arc angles-only orbit determination for a Molniya-orbit case study. Conventional Gauss Initial Orbit Determination followed by Gaussian Least-Squares Differential Correction is first shown to be unreliable under high-noise short-arc conditions, frequently failing to converge or converging to hyperbolic local solutions.
